title: EvoMCP: Co-evolving MCP agents and training data
title_zh: EvoMCP：MCP智能体与训练数据的共同演化

paragraphs.en: 提出EvoMCP智能体-数据共同演化框架，通过闭环微调在多个MCP基准上取得显著提升。 Supervised fine-tuning of Model Context Protocol (MCP) agents is typically conducted on a static data distribution, which fails to adapt to the student's evolving capabilities and leaves newly exposed weaknesses insufficiently addressed. To address these challenges, we propose \method, an agent--data mutual evolution framework that enables MCP agents to improve through a closed loop of task evolution, trajectory evolution, and supervised fine-tuning. Specifically, \method\ assesses the student's established capabilities and capability gaps from rollout feedback to identify learning targets. Task evolution then translates these targets into executable tasks by adapting the instructions and observable environment states of compatible verified seed tasks while keeping their verifiers aligned. To provide reliable and efficient demonstrations for these tasks, trajectory evolution uses reusable skills to recover failed teacher rollouts and refine successful ones. The resulting task--trajectory pairs are used to fine-tune the student, while accepted tasks seed subsequent evolution. To close the loop, we re-evaluate the updated student and use its feedback to guide the next round of data evolution. Experiments on Toolathlon, MCPMark, and MCP-Atlas demonstrate consistent improvements over the initial student, yielding absolute gains of 16.5\%, 10.2\%, and 12.6\%, respectively. Project page: https://github.com/xagao/EvoMCP.
paragraphs.zh: 提出EvoMCP智能体-数据共同演化框架，通过闭环微调在多个MCP基准上取得显著提升。模型上下文协议（MCP）智能体的监督微调通常在静态数据分布上进行，无法适应学生的能力演变，也未能充分弥补新暴露的弱点。 为应对这些挑战，我们提出\method，这是一个智能体-数据相互演化框架，使MCP智能体通过任务演化、轨迹演化和监督微调构成的闭环不断改进。 具体而言，\method\ 从 rollout 反馈中评估学生已具备的能力与能力缺口，以确定学习目标。 任务演化随后通过调整兼容的已验证种子任务的指令与可观察环境状态，同时保持其验证器一致，将这些目标转化为可执行任务。 为了为这些任务提供可靠且高效的示范，轨迹演化利用可复用技能来挽救失败的教师 rollout 并改进成功的 rollout。 由此得到的任务-轨迹对用于微调学生，而被接受的任务则作为后续演化的种子。 为闭合这一循环，我们重新评估更新后的学生，并利用其反馈指导下一轮数据演化。 在 Toolathlon、MCPMark 和 MCP-Atlas 上的实验表明，相较于初始学生取得了一致的提升，绝对增益分别为 16.5\%、10.2\% 和 12.6\%。 项目主页：https://github.com/xagao/EvoMCP。
